title: PRD: SSO (SAML) and Audit Log v1
content:
Feature: SAML SSO and tenant audit log for enterprise merchants. Owner: Product (Dana Whitfield).
Scope: SAML 2.0 SSO, SCIM-lite provisioning, exportable audit log of admin actions (90-day retention).
Target release per roadmap: Q3 2026. Dependencies: Identity service rewrite, security review.
Risk: identity service rewrite is behind schedule. Dates are INTERNAL and not committed to customers.

title: Roadmap Q3-Q4 2026 (published to internal teams)
content:
Q3 2026: SSO (SAML) and Audit Log v1 - planned GA 2026-09-30. Usage-based billing alerts - GA 2026-08-15.
Q4 2026: Multi-entity invoicing improvements, Revenue recognition export v2.
All dates are internal planning targets (Confidential - do not share with customers).

title: Slack #product-eng: SSO slip
content:
[Aug 4] Dana Whitfield: Heads up - identity service rewrite slipped. SSO and Audit Log v1 now targeting 2026-11-15 (Q4), not Sept 30.
[Aug 4] Raj Iyer: Confirmed. Security review needs 3 more weeks. Roadmap doc still shows Q3, needs update.
[Aug 4] Dana Whitfield: Do not communicate new date externally until leadership signs off.

title: Call transcript: Meridian Freight QBR
content:
Attendees: Priya Nair (AM), Tom Becker (Meridian IT Director), Lena Ortiz (Meridian Finance).
Tom: We need SSO and audit logs before our internal audit in October. Is that realistic?
Priya: I can tell you we are targeting SSO by September 30. I'll confirm in writing.
Tom: If that slips, we will have to evaluate alternatives.
Action items: Priya to send written confirmation of Sept 30 SSO target. Lena asked about 8% volume discount renewal.

title: Slack #exec-revenue: Meridian risk
content:
[Aug 9] CRO: Meridian is a high churn risk (est. 70% if SSO slips past October). ARR at risk: $420k.
[Aug 9] CFO: Authorize up to 15% retention discount if needed. Do not disclose this to the AM team yet.
[Aug 9] CRO: Legal to review any written date commitments Priya made.

title: Discount Approval Policy v1
content: Account Managers may approve discounts up to 10% on renewals without further approval. Above 10% requires Finance approval.

title: Discount Approval Policy v2 (current)
content: Effective 2026-02-01. Account Managers may approve up to 5%. Discounts above 5% up to 15% require Finance VP approval. Above 15% requires CFO approval. Supersedes v1.

title: Ticket: Meridian audit trail export request
content: Customer Meridian Freight asked how to export admin activity for their internal audit. Current product has no tenant audit log export. Workaround: manual API pull of invoice and subscription events via events endpoint. Status: Open, linked to feature request FR-221.

title: Ticket: Brightpath audit log request
content: Customer Brightpath Health asked for admin activity export for HIPAA review. No tenant audit log export exists. Workaround: manual events API pull. Status: Open, linked to FR-221.

title: Call transcript: Brightpath HIPAA discussion
content: Attendees: Marco Silva (AM), Hannah Cole (Brightpath CISO). Hannah asked for a BAA and HIPAA-ready data handling. Marco said BAA is handled by Legal and no date for audit log was promised. Expansion: +40 seats under discussion.

title: Ticket: Cobalt onboarding failure NetSuite sync
content: Cobalt Retail onboarding blocked. NetSuite sync failed with error: subsidiary mapping missing. Fix: map Cobalt subsidiary in integration settings, re-run sync. Resolved on 2026-07-24.

title: Data Retention Policy
content: Customer billing records are retained 7 years. Support ticket attachments retained 2 years. Call recordings retained 18 months. Audit logs retained 90 days (product) and 1 year (internal systems).

title: Release notes: Usage-based billing alerts (beta)
content: Usage-based billing alerts are in public beta. Merchants can set threshold notifications on metered usage. GA planned in a later release.

title: Public docs: Dunning and payment recovery
content: Dunning retries failed payments on a configurable schedule, sends reminder emails, and can pause or cancel subscriptions after final failure.

title: Customer Communication Policy for Roadmap
content: Roadmap dates are never committed to customers in writing without Product and Legal approval. Use 'targeting' language only for L0 public roadmap items.

content: Marco: Brightpath expansion +40 seats likely to close in August. HIPAA BAA is the blocker. Quote validity 30 days.

title: Access Review Policy
content: Privileged access reviewed quarterly. Access removed within 24 hours of role change.

title: Escalation Policy
content: P1 incidents escalate to on-call manager within 30 minutes. Customer comms approved by Support Lead.

title: PCI Scope Policy
content: Card data is never stored in tickets or Slack. Agents must redact PANs. Hosted pages keep card data out of merchant scope.

title: Vendor Risk Policy
content: Vendors handling customer data require security review and annual reassessment.

title: Incident Response Policy
content: Security incidents are logged, triaged within 1 hour, and reviewed post-incident within 5 business days.

title: Release notes: Multi-currency invoicing improvements
content: Multi-currency invoices now show exchange rate source and timestamp.

title: Public docs: Subscription proration
content: Proration credits unused time on upgrade, charges remaining period at the new price.

title: Public docs: Webhooks
content: Webhooks retry with exponential backoff for up to 3 days on non-2xx responses.

title: Public trust page summary
content: Trust summary (simulated): SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI DSS Level 1 service provider.
